{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgN16JUnEgXszz6TXmVtt","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Type-Text-Empty.md ===\n# FEATURE: Type Text and Empty\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Complete the column type ladder with the text fallback and the empty type for columns without non-null values. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-Type-Boolean.md, FEATURE-Null-Values.md |\n| Provides    | type text, type empty |\n| Consumes    | csvdata.IsNull |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nFinish the first-match type ladder `integer`, `number`, `date`, `boolean`, `text`, and add `empty`. After this story every column of every readable file has a type token in the `type` field of the profile row.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- A column with no non-null value has type `empty`. This includes a column whose values are all null (empty, `NA`, `N/A`, `NULL` in any case) and every column of a file with a header and no data records.\n- Otherwise the column takes the first of `integer`, `number`, `date`, `boolean` that every non-null value satisfies; if none is satisfied the type is `text`.\n- Nulls never decide the type; they are removed before the ladder runs.\n- Values are trimmed before classification.\n- A date-shaped value that is not a real calendar date (`2025-02-30`) does not satisfy `date`; with no other match the column is `text`.\n- Forms such as `1.`, `1e3`, `yes`, and `no` satisfy no numeric or boolean rule and fall to `text`.\n\n## Suite Pattern\n\nThe project's own `go test` suite covers the ladder directly in `internal/infer` (one test per type, null-only column, empty slice, mixed columns, order of precedence).\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC typ005-ladder ===\nIntent: Each column resolves to the first matching type in the ladder, with text as the fallback.\nSuite: scoped\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\ndef run_profile(columns, *opts):\n    names = list(columns)\n    n = len(columns[names[0]])\n    buf = io.StringIO()\n    w = csv.writer(buf, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n    w.writerow(names)\n    for i in range(n):\n        w.writerow([columns[c][i] for c in names])\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            f.write(buf.getvalue())\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*opts, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return {r[\"column\"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out))}\n\ncases = {\n    \"ints\": ([\"1\", \"-2\", \"30\"], \"integer\"),\n    \"nums\": ([\"1\", \"2.5\", \"-3.25\"], \"number\"),\n    \"dates\": ([\"2025-01-31\", \"2024-02-29\", \"2025-12-01\"], \"date\"),\n    \"bools\": ([\"true\", \"FALSE\", \"False\"], \"boolean\"),\n    \"texts\": ([\"abc\", \"1\", \"2025-01-01\"], \"text\"),\n}\ncolumns = {name: values for name, (values, _) in cases.items()}\nrows = run_profile(columns)\nfor name, (values, expected) in cases.items():\n    assert rows[name][\"type\"] == expected, (name, rows[name])\n    assert rows[name][\"rows\"] == str(len(values)), (name, rows[name])\n=== END AC typ005-ladder ===\n\n=== AC typ005-nulls-do-not-decide ===\nIntent: Null values and padding are ignored when choosing the type, and an all-null column is empty.\nSuite: scoped\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\ndef run_profile(columns, *opts):\n    names = list(columns)\n    n = len(columns[names[0]])\n    buf = io.StringIO()\n    w = csv.writer(buf, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n    w.writerow(names)\n    for i in range(n):\n        w.writerow([columns[c][i] for c in names])\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            f.write(buf.getvalue())\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*opts, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return {r[\"column\"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out))}\n\ncases = {\n    \"allnull\": ([\"\", \"NA\", \"n/a\", \"NULL\"], \"empty\"),\n    \"ints_nulls\": ([\"7\", \"\", \"NULL\", \"8\"], \"integer\"),\n    \"bools_nulls\": ([\"TRUE\", \"na\", \"\", \"false\"], \"boolean\"),\n    \"padded\": ([\" 5 \", \"6 \", \"  7\", \"N/A\"], \"integer\"),\n    \"spaces_only\": ([\"   \", \" \", \"\", \"NA\"], \"empty\"),\n}\ncolumns = {name: values for name, (values, _) in cases.items()}\nrows = run_profile(columns)\nfor name, (values, expected) in cases.items():\n    assert rows[name][\"type\"] == expected, (name, rows[name])\n=== END AC typ005-nulls-do-not-decide ===\n\n=== AC typ005-header-only-empty ===\nIntent: Every column of a file with a header and no data records has type empty and zero rows.\nSuite: scoped\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\nnames = [\"sku\", \"price\", \"in_stock\"]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n        f.write(\",\".join(names) + \"\\n\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0, code\nrows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert [r[\"column\"] for r in rows] == names\nfor r in rows:\n    assert r[\"type\"] == \"empty\", r\n    assert r[\"rows\"] == str(0), r\n=== END AC typ005-header-only-empty ===\n\n=== AC typ005-text-fallback ===\nIntent: Values that look close to a typed form but do not satisfy it make the column text.\nSuite: scoped\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\ndef run_profile(columns, *opts):\n    names = list(columns)\n    n = len(columns[names[0]])\n    buf = io.StringIO()\n    w = csv.writer(buf, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n    w.writerow(names)\n    for i in range(n):\n        w.writerow([columns[c][i] for c in names])\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            f.write(buf.getvalue())\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*opts, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return {r[\"column\"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out))}\n\ncolumns = {\n    \"bad_date\": [\"2025-02-30\", \"2025-01-01\"],\n    \"trailing_dot\": [\"1.\", \"2\"],\n    \"exponent\": [\"1e3\", \"5\"],\n    \"yes_no\": [\"yes\", \"no\"],\n    \"bool_maybe\": [\"true\", \"maybe\"],\n    \"plus_sign\": [\"+1\", \"2\"],\n}\nrows = run_profile(columns)\nfor name in columns:\n    assert rows[name][\"type\"] == \"text\", (name, rows[name])\n=== END AC typ005-text-fallback ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Do not read `sources/run.sh` or any supplied data file from application code, and do not hardcode a type.\n- Typing uses only the standard library.\n- A column is `empty` only when it has no non-null value; a column with at least one non-null value is never `empty`.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Profile-Counts.md ===\n# FEATURE: Profile Counts\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Compute the null count and the exact distinct count of non-null values for every profiled column. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-Profile-Rows.md, FEATURE-Null-Values.md |\n| Provides    | profile nulls, distinct |\n| Consumes    | csvdata.IsNull |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nFill the `nulls` and `distinct` fields of each profile row. The `rows` field is already produced by the profile rows story.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- `nulls` is the number of values in the column that are null: empty, or `NA`, `N/A`, `NULL` in any letter case, after trimming.\n- `distinct` is the number of different non-null values compared as exact strings after trimming. Case differences count as different values (`Abc` and `abc`), and so do `1`, `01`, and `1.0`.\n- `0`, `none`, and `nan` are not null.\n- A column with no non-null values has `distinct` 0; a header-only file reports `nulls` 0 and `distinct` 0 for every column.\n- Both counts are written as plain integers.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC prf002-counts ===\nIntent: nulls and distinct match counts derived from the fixture values by the stated rules.\nSuite: scoped\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\ndef run_profile(columns, *opts):\n    names = list(columns)\n    n = len(columns[names[0]])\n    buf = io.StringIO()\n    w = csv.writer(buf, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n    w.writerow(names)\n    for i in range(n):\n        w.writerow([columns[c][i] for c in names])\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            f.write(buf.getvalue())\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*opts, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return {r[\"column\"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out))}\n\ndef is_null(v):\n    return v.strip().lower() in (\"\", \"na\", \"n/a\", \"null\")\n\ncolumns = {\n    \"a\": [\"x\", \"x\", \"y\", \"\", \"NA\"],\n    \"b\": [\"Abc\", \"abc\", \"ABC\", \"NULL\", \"N/A\"],\n    \"c\": [\" x \", \"x\", \"x \", \"\", \" \"],\n    \"d\": [\"1\", \"01\", \"1.0\", \"1\", \"NULL\"],\n    \"allnull\": [\"\", \"\", \"NA\", \"null\", \"n/A\"],\n}\nrows = run_profile(columns)\nfor name, values in columns.items():\n    trimmed = [v.strip() for v in values]\n    expected_nulls = sum(1 for v in trimmed if is_null(v))\n    expected_distinct = len(set(v for v in trimmed if not is_null(v)))\n    assert rows[name][\"rows\"] == str(len(values)), (name, rows[name])\n    assert rows[name][\"nulls\"] == str(expected_nulls), (name, rows[name])\n    assert rows[name][\"distinct\"] == str(expected_distinct), (name, rows[name])\n=== END AC prf002-counts ===\n\n=== AC prf002-non-null-lookalikes ===\nIntent: Values such as 0, none, and nan are counted as distinct non-null values.\nSuite: scoped\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\ndef run_profile(columns, *opts):\n    names = list(columns)\n    n = len(columns[names[0]])\n    buf = io.StringIO()\n    w = csv.writer(buf, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n    w.writerow(names)\n    for i in range(n):\n        w.writerow([columns[c][i] for c in names])\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            f.write(buf.getvalue())\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*opts, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return {r[\"column\"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out))}\n\nvalues = [\"0\", \"0\", \"none\", \"nan\", \"\"]\nrows = run_profile({\"e\": values})\nexpected_nulls = sum(1 for v in values if v == \"\")\nexpected_distinct = len(set(v for v in values if v != \"\"))\nassert rows[\"e\"][\"nulls\"] == str(expected_nulls), rows[\"e\"]\nassert rows[\"e\"][\"distinct\"] == str(expected_distinct), rows[\"e\"]\n=== END AC prf002-non-null-lookalikes ===\n\n=== AC prf002-header-only ===\nIntent: A header-only file reports zero rows, nulls, and distinct for every column.\nSuite: scoped\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\nnames = [\"sku\", \"price\", \"in_stock\"]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n    path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n        f.write(\",\".join(names) + \"\\n\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0, code\nrows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert len(rows) == len(names)\nfor r in rows:\n    assert r[\"rows\"] == str(0), r\n    assert r[\"nulls\"] == str(0), r\n    assert r[\"distinct\"] == str(0), r\n=== END AC prf002-header-only ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Distinct compares exact trimmed strings; never normalize case or numeric form.\n- Null values are never counted as distinct values.\n- Do not hardcode any count; every value comes from the file examined.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Profile-Numeric-Stats.md ===\n# FEATURE: Profile Numeric Stats\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Compute exact sum, mean, and median for integer and number columns using arbitrary-precision rational arithmetic. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-Type-Text-Empty.md, FEATURE-Profile-Counts.md |\n| Provides    | profile sum, mean, median |\n| Consumes    | infer types, internal/decimal |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nFill the `sum`, `mean`, and `median` fields for columns typed `integer` or `number`. All arithmetic is exact (`math/big`, `big.Rat`); rounding happens once, when the value is written.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Only non-null values participate. The count used for the mean is the non-null count.\n- `sum`: integer columns write the integer total; number columns write the total with exactly two decimal places.\n- `mean`: sum divided by the non-null count, written with two decimal places for both integer and number columns.\n- `median`: the middle value of the numerically sorted non-null values, or the mean of the two middle values when the count is even; written with two decimal places for both types.\n- Sorting is numeric, never lexical (`9` sorts before `10`).\n- For every other type (`text`, `date`, `boolean`, `empty`) the three fields are empty.\n- `internal/decimal` provides the formatter that rounds a `big.Rat` once, half away from zero, to two decimals.
